title: Valles Marineris
subtitle: Viking orbital overview
summary: Valles Marineris is a connected canyon system extending from Noctis Labyrinthus toward chaotic terrain in the east. Viking imagery shows its immense scale and layered interior.
whyGo: Map structural breaks, layered deposits and access hazards before selecting a future exploration zone.
